youtube_description:
This is our very first video! I give you a quick rundown of my setup when I go camping, overlanding, or just relaxing in the back of my Tacoma truck under the Softopper. Here you see my Jackery power station powering a fan, chromebook tablet, water pressure container, and my truck bed sleeping platform. Thanks for watching! 

Items in this video:

BamBeds Sleeping Platform for Tacoma: https://bambeds.com?sca_ref=2860979.4ZMM6ijiHs&sca_source=YT-1st

Jackery 300 Power Station: https://amzn.to/3twhet4

Vornado Fan: https://amzn.to/3Twc9eZ

Water Container: https://amzn.to/3ExwzzZ 

HP X2 Chromebook: https://amzn.to/3E6RKHy

Visit my website @ https://dirtnsmores.com
